head: Singing Santa Apple Watch face: tap and Santa dances and sings
dek: Singing Santa Watchface is a 1.99-dollar Apple Watch app with a Santa in a Christmas scene who dances and sings a Christmas song when you tap the screen. It came out on 22 November and was #52 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: It has 10 backgrounds, 10 clock styles and 30 colour themes, and can show the weather, heart rate, steps and battery. You set it up with a companion iPhone app. It needs watchOS 10 and iOS 17 or newer. It's made by Cristian Loloiu and had no ratings yet.
where: Apple Watch with iPhone, App Store, 1.99 dollars
means: If you want something festive on your wrist for December, this is a one-off purchase with no subscription mentioned.
todo: Check that your watch runs watchOS 10 or newer before you buy it from the App Store.
thumb_words: SANTA SINGS ON YOUR APPLE WATCH
